errors.description: The CANDIDATE does not mention the importance of distinguishing visual field loss from neglect or broader perceptual issues during OT assessment.
The CANDIDATE rates the falls risk as moderate, while the REFERENCE rates it as high due to the field loss already contributing to a fall.

rationale: The CANDIDATE covers most of the important functional content from the REFERENCE, with only minor omissions and a slight discrepancy in falls risk level. It is factually consistent with the SOURCE report and avoids unsupported additions. The CANDIDATE is clinically safe and would serve an OT well with minor adjustments.
